links.reason: Both poems do name Anji (352 l.12 நெடுந்தேர் அஞ்சி, 92 l.6 நெடுமான் அஞ்சி), but what 352 praises is the பண் a பாண்மகன் made for Anji's நல்லிசை (ll.13-16), not Avvai's words. 92 calls its own words யாழொடும் கொள்ளா. So the teaches sentence, that Avvai's 'babble' became a byword for sweetness, mixes up the bard and Avvai. What the two poems share is a patron and a contrast about fitting words to music, not a shared image.

Item 3, பாத்துண்ணும் தன்மையி லாளர் அயலிருப்பு, is the other side of 322's பகுத்துண்டு, and the verse counts living beside such people as yielding no good (நன்மை பயத்தல் இல). That makes the non-sharer a loss to his neighbours. The list really does put him with a town without கணக்காயர் and an assembly without மூத்தோர், three lacks of a place.
links.text_issue: l.3 இம்முன்றும் is a misprint for இம்மூன்றும்

links.reason: The two meet on a specific act, providing water (கூவல் தொட்டான்; நீர்நிலை பெருகத் தட்டோர்). But the outward/inward contrast is false: Puram 18 also rewards the builder himself, saying that those who dam water have secured the next world's wealth, sole rule and நல்இசை (ll.13-16, 29). The சாவா உடம்பு of Thirikadugam is most plausibly fame, which is not an inward reward.

The pairing has a real gradient: 720's nectar is only wasted in the அங்கணம், but Pazhamozhi says சொல்லிய நல்லவும் தீயவாம், good words turn bad. The kinship frame does rest on the proverb's தமரையில்லார்க்கு set against 720's தங்கணத்தார். The proverb is about the person with no kin, so the list_adds point holds.
links.text_issue: l.1 சுழிநுட்பம் where 12 and 13 have கழிநுட்பம்

links.reason: Naladiyar 270 says only ஓதாதும் (without study); it does not exclude கேள்வி. Pazhamozhi 11 explicitly allows hearing (கேட்டானும்) as a route, so the incompatibility depends on stretching 270. Also, the lucky hit in l.3 is given to the அறிவில்லான், the man without sense, who matches 270's உணர்விலார், not its உணர்வுடையார். So list_adds and teaches misplace the case.
links.text_issue: l.1 சுற்றானும் சுற்றார்வாய் is corrupt; the sense depends on emending to கற்றானும் கற்றார்வாய்

links.reason: Item 1, வான்புகழ் நட்டான், echoes 233's உயர்ந்த புகழ், and சாவா உடம்பு echoes பொன்றாது நிற்பது. The verse then adds a கற்புடையாள் and a கூவல் as equal routes to the same deathlessness. It widens the routes and does not contradict 233.

Item 3, ஊழினால் ஒட்டி வினைநலம் பார்ப்பான், is close to 813's உறுவது சீர்தூக்கும் நட்பு. But the claim that he 'shows himself at the turn of fortune' rests on an uncertain reading of ஊழினால் ஒட்டி. Only item 2 names the fall (தாழ்விடத்து). Item 1, பொய்வழங்கி வாழும் பொறியறை, says nothing about reversal, so 'three who fail at reversal' is not true of the list.
links.text_issue: sense of பொறியறை, தட்டை and ஊழினால் ஒட்டி is uncertain

links.reason: Thirikadugam's சொல்லின் அரில் அகற்றும் கேள்வியார் matches 417's ஈண்டிய கேள்வியவர் who do not speak பேதைமை. The verse makes their நட்பு a மருந்து, so the benefit goes to the person who befriends them. That is a real extension of a trait that 417 keeps to the learned man himself.

The pairing is apt: பிறப்பு heads the eight things that ஒழுக்கம் பிழையாதவர் gain, while 133 makes ஒழுக்கம் itself குடிமை. But 133's second half (இழுக்கம் இழிந்த பிறப்பாய் விடும்) also makes birth a result of conduct, so the two run in the same direction. Neither puts a condition on the other, and qualifies does not fit.

கல்லார்க்கு இனனாய் ஒழுகல் matches 451's சிற்றினம் சுற்றமாச் சூழ்தல. The verse supplies a cause, அறியாமையால், and a result, கேடு, that 451 does not give. The grouping with wife-beating and entering a house with சிறியார் is accurately reported, though calling all three 'householder' failures is a gloss.

The note is accurate: Acharakkovai 20 governs facing east, posture, silence and worship (திசைகிழக்கு, தூங்கான், உரையான், தொழுதுகொண்டு), and 942 governs digestion (அற்றது போற்றி). But teaches itself says that neither addresses the other's concern. What they share is the topic of eating, not a pattern carried into a new domain, so parallel_domain does not fit.

414's கற்றிலனாயினும் கேட்க concedes hearing as what remains. Pazhamozhi 11 names the same two routes, study and கேட்டானும், and condemns the man who has neither (இல்லாதார் தெற்ற உணரார்). Its proverb (நாவற் கீழ்ப் பெற்ற கனி) leaves him only luck. The hearing half is sound text, though the study half rests on an emendation.
links.text_issue: l.1 சுற்றானும் சுற்றார்வாய் is corrupt for கற்றானும் கற்றார்வாய்

links.reason: The shared சோர்வு படும் and the learned hearers (கற்றார்முன்) are a real tie. But in Pazhamozhi 12 it is the speech or insight that falters, not the man's standing (தகைமை), which the note claims. The proverb வினாமுந்துறாத உரையில்லை more naturally says that speech should follow a question, so it may fault unasked speech. The 'mechanism' that every claim must survive questions is one uncertain reading.

காவாது உரை does meet 127's நாகாக்க / காவாக்கால். But 'chosen, not lapsed into' is not in the Tamil: வீழக் களியாதான் is an uncertain negative participle, and the verse says only that the town is pained (ஊரெல்லாம் நோவது). The real addition is the social cost, which the teaches sentence passes over for an inference about will.
links.text_issue: sense of விளியாதான், களியாதான், தெளியாதான் is uncertain

links.reason: Both verses figure the unlearned man's ambition as desire without the faculty, with a bodily lack (முலையிரண்டும் இல்லாதாள்; தானும் நடவான் முடவன்). Pazhamozhi's கறுப்பித்து and சுனைத்தெழுதல் make it a challenge, not just a wish to speak. A lame man wanting to play with a யானை does carry danger as well as incapacity.
links.text_issue: பிடிப்பூணி, சொற்றாற்று and சுனைத்து are obscure

links.reason: அஞ்சுவான் கற்ற அருநூல் nearly repeats 727's அவையகத்து அஞ்சுமவன் கற்ற நூல், so agrees fits. The two images differ as teaches says: a sword unused against பகை, and a dream that a mute (ஊமன்) cannot tell. The rest of the list does group goods held that cannot be brought out.

Acharakkovai 7 classes இணைவிழைச்சு and eating as எச்சில். Sivavakkiyar's துச்சில் எச்சில் அல்லவோ தூயகாயம் ஆனதும் hits exactly the union item: the body itself comes from it, and honey and milk are எச்சில் too. The two speak of the same category, and the note keeps the rule as a stated norm.

The ஒழுக்கம் / இழுக்கம் pair is shared, and Pazhamozhi applies it to speaking before கல்லாதவர். But the proverb's words (மிக்க இழிவில்லை, மிக்க உயர்வு) are not 137's (எய்துவர் மேன்மை, எய்தாப் பழி). Calling it 'the Kural's couplet circulating as a proverb' claims a derivation the texts do not show.

Pazhamozhi 13 says the unlearned man's insight is hard to show (காட்டரிது), so there is no point rating himself good (சொல்லாக்கால் சொல்லுவதில்). It does not place him among the learned or deal with his speaking. So 'both refuse the unlearned any good way to be present among the learned' overstates 13: that closure needs verse 12 as well.

பார்ப்பார் is one of the things not to be scorned (இகழ்வானேல்), and 134 says a பார்ப்பான்'s பிறப்பு கெடும் when conduct fails. The two speak of related things. But 134 speaks of the brahmin's own status, not of the reverence others owe, and Acharakkovai 15 does not say that birth alone commands it. The 'disagreement' is the note's inference, not either text's claim.

19's எல்லிற் பிறன்கடை நின்றொழுகுவான் is the act of which 9's உரிமையில் பெண்டிரைக் காமுற்று வாழ்தல் is the desire. 19 sets it between running at a கொல்யானை and playing with a snake, so the 'mortal danger' reading of தூங்குபவர் is supported by its company. The pairing really does show the book judging the act both as wanted folly and as danger.
links.text_issue: தூங்குபவர் may also mean the heedless sleeper

links.reason: Both use the same working image: the strong பகடு hauling a salt cart's sunken wheel out of the rut (ஆரைச் சாகாட்டு ஆழ்ச்சி போக்கும் உரனுடை நோன்பகடு; அள்ளல் அழுந்திய சாகாட்டு ... பகட்டின் வருந்தி). Puram praises the ox's strength in the king, while akam takes the ox's strain and hot breathing (வெய்ய உயிர்க்கும்) for the lover's pain.

Both concern எச்சில் of the mouth, and the Siddhar's வாயிலே குதப்புவேதம் does turn the category on recitation. But Acharakkovai 5 is a touch rule listing பசு, பார்ப்பார், தீ, தேவர் and the crown, and it makes no claim about what counts as எச்சில். 1004 attacks the definition, not this rule, so the tension is indirect: Acharakkovai 7 or 8 would meet it more squarely.

4's தந்தையும் தாயும் தொழுதெழுக is the daily act, and 16 ranks தாய் and தந்தை among five நிகரில் குரவர் to be worshipped தேவரைப் போல. The pair really shows that the dawn rite names only two of the five. Both verses are stated as reported norms (முந்தையோர் கண்ட முறை; யாவரும் கண்ட நெறி).

The verbal match is close: ஒப்ப நாடி அத்தக ஒறுத்தி against தக்காங்கு நாடி ... ஒத்தாங்கு ஒறுப்பது. Puram 10 also adds mercy on submission (வந்து அடி பொருந்தி ... தண்டமும் தணிதி), which 561 lacks. 'Reads like a rule drawn out of praise' is hedged rather than asserted.

The verse makes eight virtues the வித்து of ஆசாரம். But the teaches sentence says the conduct to be guarded 'is not a set of rules', which contradicts the verse's own aim of rooting a code of rules, and equates the ritual ஆசாரம் with 131's ஒழுக்கம் without comment. list_adds is accurate; teaches is not.

Naladiyar 255's worthy (சான்றவர் சொல்லார்), silent even when asked (கடாஅயினும்), are a real counterpart to Pazhamozhi's warning about speaking கல்லார்முன். But the quatrain gives its own reason, பொருண்மேல் படாஅ (it will not be taken in). It does not leave 'good turning bad' implicit; that reversal (நல்லவும் தீயவாம்) is a different and stronger claim.

The note states the reading the conflict depends on: புலை as a person set with நாய் among sights barred to எச்சிலார். Read that way, the rule ranks a birth-group as polluting, against 972's பிறப்பொக்கும் எல்லா உயிர்க்கும். The teaches sentence rightly makes the conflict hang on புலை and செய்தொழில், and the note treats the rule as a historical norm.
links.text_issue: sense of புலை and தக்கவீழ் மீன் uncertain

links.reason: செருப்புக் குறையெனினும் கொள்ளார் இரந்து really does bring 1066's limit case of begging (ஆவிற்கு நீர்) down to one's own small want, and puts it in a list of bodily rules. But the verse does not call begging a defilement. Its first two rules use தீண்டார் while the third uses கொள்ளார் இரந்து, so list_adds' 'kind of defilement' goes beyond the text.

பெருமையுடையார் இனத்தின் அகறல் matches 450's நல்லார் தொடர்கைவிடல். 450 measures the harm (பத்தடுத்த தீமை), and Thirikadugam's predicate முழுமக்கள் காதலவை makes it something fools want. The grouping with adulterous desire and base resolve as things loved is accurate.

verses.note: நால்வகை counts the kinds of எச்சில், not the prohibitions (ஓதார், உரையார், வளரார்), so no items are counted.
An invocation listing three deeds of Mal, not counsel; domain set to all by default.
Gift, sacrifice and learning are householder duties but தவம் is the ascetic's; the majority audience is taken.
The count word is fused as சிறுமைஇம் மூன்றும்.
நான்மறையாளர் (the Veda-knowers) is set as the path to follow, read as a varna term; it could be taken as learning only.
The three address kin, king and ascetic respectively; no majority, so all.
கீழ்மக்கள் மெய்யுறல் in a touch-pollution rule is read as birth rank; the split of ஊண்பொழுது and வைகு துயில் into separate items is uncertain.
வேளாளன் is redefined by conduct (not eating while a guest waits), not used as a birth rank.
The three address the old man, the husband and the ascetic; item 2 states a husband's duty at his wife's season.
புலை in a rule on what not to look at is read as birth rank.
